Angel One Founder Buys Mumbai Tower for ₹711 Crore

Dinesh Thakkar, founder, chairman, and managing director of the digital stockbroking company Angel One, has purchased an eight-story residential tower in Mumbai's Juhu area for ₹711 crore. He signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for the deal.
